# Plugin.Maui.LocalNotifications

Schedule / cancel local notifications and route taps for .NET MAUI.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.LocalNotifications
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.LocalNotifications
Paper: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-local-notifications/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Current release

1.0.2. Host apps must declare Android and iOS permissions listed in the README.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.LocalNotifications

Registration: `UseLocalNotifications` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I schedule a local notification in MAUI?
- Cancel pending local alerts
- Notification tap actions without FCM

## Do not use when

- FCM / APNs token registration
- Remote payload routing (use Plugin.Maui.PushRouter)
